title: Subcritical sharpness for real-valued spin models
summary: In this paper, we consider a large family of real-valued spin models on general transitive graphs. We show that, in the subcritical regime $β<β_c$, the correlations of the model decay exponentially fast. To prove this result, we consider the random cluster (a.k.a. FK percolation) representation of the model and obtain an inequality that generalises the OSSS inequality to monotonic measures with random connection probabilities, thus extending the inequality of Duminil-Copin, Raoufi, and Tassion.
